operations.description: This API is used to add components to a cluster.

This API is used to batch add tags to a specified cluster. A cluster can have a maximum of 10 tags. This API is idempotent. - If a tag to be created has the same key as an existing tag in the cluster, the tag will overwrite the existing one.

This API is used to batch delete tags from a specified cluster. A cluster can have a maximum of 10 tags. This API is idempotent. - When tags are being deleted and some tags do not exist, the operation is considered successful by default. The character set of the tags will not be checked. A key and a value can respectively contain up to 36 and 43 Unicode characters. The tags structure cannot be missing during deletion. The key cannot be empty or an empty string.
This API is used to delete jobs in batches from an MRS cluster.
This API is used to cancel the execution task of a SQL statement in the MRS cluster.
This API is used to cancel synchronization of specified users and user groups.

This API is used to add tags to a specified cluster. A cluster can have a maximum of 10 tags. This API is idempotent. If a tag to be created has the same key as an existing tag, the tag will overwrite the existing one.
This API is used to create data connections.

This API is used to add and submit a job in an MRS cluster. On the **Dashboard** tab of the cluster details page, click **Click to synchronize** on the right of **IAM User Sync** to synchronize IAM users. Then submit a job through this API. To use the OBS encryption function, perform related configurations by referring to **Managing an Existing Cluster** > **Job Management** > **Using Encrypted OBS Data for Job Running** in the **MRS User Guide** and then call the API to run a job. The OBS paths, sample files, endpoints, and AK/SK involved in all examples must be obtained in advance and replaced with the actual ones when you submit a request.
This API is used to configure an auto scaling rule. You can also create an auto scaling rule using the APIs for creating a cluster and executing a job.

This API is used to delete a cluster after data processing and analysis are completed or the cluster is abnormal. This API is compatible with Sahara. Clusters in any of the following states cannot be deleted: - scaling-out: The cluster is being scaled out. - scaling-in: The cluster is being scaled in. - starting: The cluster is being started. - terminating: The cluster is being terminated. - terminated: The cluster has been terminated. - failed: The cluster failed.
This API is used to delete tags from a specified cluster.
This API is used to delete a data connection.
This API is used to submit and execute a SQL statement in an MRS cluster.
This API is used to scale out an MRS cluster.
This API is used to query all tags of a specified region.
Obtain current cluster agency switch task status
This API is used to query the ID of the AZ, which you will need to create a cluster.
Query the authorization status of the cluster interface
Query the authorization status of cluster nodes
This API is used to query tags of a specified cluster.
This API is used to query a list of clusters created by a user. This API is incompatible with Sahara.
This API is used to filter clusters by tag. By default, clusters and tags are sorted in descending order of creation time.
This API is used to query a data connection list.
This API is used to query a host list of a specified cluster.
This API is used to query the cluster node list.
Obtain current cluster communication security authorization status
Query IAM synchronization status for a specified cluster
Check whether the current cluster is undergoing IAM synchronization

This API is used to create an MRS cluster, submit a job, and terminate the cluster after the job is complete. This API is supported in MRS 1.8.9 or later. Before using this API, you need to obtain the following resource information: - Create or query a VPC and subnet. - Create or query a key pair using an ECS. - Obtain the region information by referring to[1.3-Endpoints](https://support.huaweicloud.com/api-mrs/mrs_02_0003.html) - Obtain the MRS version and the components supported by the MRS version by referring to [10.8-Obtaining the MRS Cluster Information](https://support.huaweicloud.com/api-mrs/mrs_02_9001.html).
This API is used to obtain details about the mapping between a user or user group and an IAM agency.
This API is used to view all auto scaling policies of a specified cluster.
This API is used to query details about a specified cluster. This API is incompatible with Sahara.
This API is used to obtain the list of files from a specified directory in an MRS cluster.
This API is used to query the job list in a specified MRS cluster.
Querying Available Specifications of an MRS Cluster Version
This API is used to obtain MRS versions.
This API is used to query the metadata of a cluster. If the cluster ID is specified, the latest metadata of the cluster that has been patched can be queried.
This API is used to query information about a specified job in an MRS cluster.
This API is used to query the execution result of a SQL statement in the MRS cluster.
This API is used to obtain results returned after the SQL statements for querying SparkSQL and SparkScript jobs in an MRS cluster are executed.
This API is used to obtain synchronized IAM users and user groups.
This API is used to scale in an MRS cluster.
This API is used to terminate a specified job in an MRS cluster.
This API is used to update the mapping between a user or user group and an IAM agency.
Enable/Disable cluster interface authorization
Updating the Cluster Name

This API is used to manually add or remove core or task nodes in a cluster that has been created. After an MRS cluster is created, the number of master nodes cannot be adjusted. This API is incompatible with Sahara Only clusters in the running state can be scaled out or in. For details about the cluster status and ID, see [Querying a Cluster List](https://support.huaweicloud.com/en-us/api-mrs/mrs_02_0030.html)."
Enable/Disable cluster node authorization
This API is used to update a data connection.
This API is used to synchronize IAM users and user groups to Manager. If a user is specified, the IAM user group the user belongs is also synchronized.
